messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (duplicate) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is the core problem still open, not solved by a shipped story and not covered by a roadmap item? Pass means yes.
Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.
The evidence is the problem statement and the five most similar stories and roadmap pages, with status and dates.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "problem_statement": "Claims handlers struggle with outdated or unclear processes, making it hard to track tasks and handle documents efficiently. This delays resolutions and reduces team productivity.",
 "similar": [
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4127",
   "similarity": 0.064,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": true, \"completed_at\": \"2026-10-06T00:00:00Z\", \"description\": \"Users can now upload multiple documents at once to a claim in Keelwater, streamlining the process and reducing manual effort for claims handlers.\", \"id\": 4127, \"name\": \"Bulk upload documents to a claim\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 3}"
  },
  {
   "source": "notion",
   "id": "3725e3b1-1ae8-55a3-9286-7db8d9b8fbd5",
   "similarity": 0.049,
   "record": "{\"id\": \"3725e3b1-1ae8-55a3-9286-7db8d9b8fbd5\", \"object\": \"page\", \"properties\": {\"Name\": {\"title\": [{\"plain_text\": \"Task overview\", \"text\": {\"content\": \"Task overview\"}, \"type\": \"text\"}], \"type\": \"title\"}, \"Problem\": {\"rich_text\": [{\"plain_text\": \"A centralized dashboard in Keelwater that displays all active, pending, and completed tasks related to claims processing, helping users track progress and prioritize work without switching contexts.\", \"text\": {\"content\": \"A centralized dashboard in Keelwater that displays all active, pending, and completed tasks related to claims processing, helping users track progress and prioritize work without switching contexts.\"}, \"type\": \"text\"}], \"type\": \"ri"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4128",
   "similarity": 0.038,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": true, \"completed_at\": \"2026-09-15T00:00:00Z\", \"description\": \"Keelwater now allows users to filter claims by date range, status, and claim type, making it easier to locate specific claims without scrolling through unrelated entries.\", \"id\": 4128, \"name\": \"Claim search refinements\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 3}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4130",
   "similarity": 0.037,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": true, \"completed_at\": \"2026-09-15T00:00:00Z\", \"description\": \"Keelwater now provides a clearer, more detailed payment history view, helping users track transactions, refunds, and adjustments with improved timestamps and categorization for faster reconciliation.\", \"id\": 4130, \"name\": \"Payment history improvements\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 3}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4129",
   "similarity": 0.037,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": true, \"completed_at\": \"2026-09-15T00:00:00Z\", \"description\": \"Keelwater automatically pulls and updates supplier contact details from integrated systems, ensuring claims handlers always have the most current information without manual entry.\", \"id\": 4129, \"name\": \"Supplier contact details\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 3}"
  }
 ]
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "I checked the problem's two core components—difficulty tracking tasks and handling documents efficiently—against the five similar items. Completed story 4127 'Bulk upload documents to a claim' (completed 2026-10-06) directly addresses the document-handling component, 'streamlining the process and reducing manual effort for claims handlers.' The Notion roadmap page 'Task overview' covers the task-tracking component, describing 'a centralized dashboard... helping users track progress and prioritize work without switching contexts.' The remaining stories (claim search refinements, payment history, supplier contacts) address different problems, but with a shipped story solving the document-handling piece and a roadmap item covering task tracking, the core problem is not still open.", "verdict": "fail"}
